title: chore(objectui): bump the console pin to db11afd4967c (carries objectui#11119, the objectui#11105 fix)
body:
Fixes #20638

Clause-②: no

Bumps the console pin: `.objectui-sha` `dd3f7e1be356` -> `db11afd4967c` (objectui `origin/main` HEAD at bump time, on main). The pin ships `@object-ui/console` 17.6.0 (`apps/console/package.json` at the pin and `@object-ui/core` workspace version both 17.6.0; `npm view @object-ui/console@17.6.0 version` answers 17.6.0).

## Containment (objectui `merge-base --is-ancestor C db11afd4967c`, full clone, not shallow)

| commit | subject | result |
|---|---|---|
| `a5841be351` | flow designer shows a connector action's description (objectui#11028) | exit 0, contained |
| `99878d8e3a` | validateTree no longer calls a declared bind unknown (objectui#11008) | exit 0, contained |
| `49f76725aa` | matrix report with columns draws its declared chart (objectui#10964) | exit 0, contained |
| `ae582b70a` | number field useGrouping (objectui#11026) | exit 0, contained |
| `5b2ea17570` | Studio previews show authored descriptions and labels (objectui#11027) | exit 0, contained |
| `3100bef65c` | server-grouped grid selects field names (objectui#11105, PR #11119) | exit 0, contained |
| control `dd3f7e1be3` (old pin) | | exit 0 |

The target is objectui `origin/main` HEAD (`git branch -r --contains` lists `origin/main`).

## What changed

- `.objectui-sha`, `sdui.manifest.json`, `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` (via `scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, no arguments: the `--objectui-version` route is retired per that script), and `.changeset/console-db11afd4967c.md` (written by `scripts/bump-objectui.sh`, minor).
- `pnpm objectui:build` at the new pin built the console dist (64404 KB) with no API break against framework code.

## Follow-up (pushed on this branch, two commits, written 2026-09-29T20:01Z)

Requested by the PM seat after the first report: the two gates that sat outside the first file surface.

- `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` re-recorded with `pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep` against `db11afd4967c`; `pnpm check:sdui-lockstep` now exits 0.
- The 49 spec sources that asserted the old pin were re-measured, not re-labelled: each anchor mapped through the `dd3f7e1be356..db11afd4967c` diff and re-read, hashes and counts re-taken with the method each record names, and only then the pin and the moved numbers updated. Files: `component.zod.ts`, `component.test.ts`, `view.zod.ts`, `dataset.zod.ts`, `functional-completeness.ts`, `api-methods-batch-conformance.test.ts`, six `migrations/entries/semantic/18.*` files and the regenerated `migrations/registry.ts`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:objectui-pin-citations` exits 0 (49 asserting citations match, 7 anchor content assertions verified).
- `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` regenerated with `gen:docs`: the `FormField.span` describe names the pin, so its sha moved. This is the only non-comment text change; no schema or behaviour moved.
- One claim was falsified, not just moved: objectui#5157 closed `ObjectMapConfigSchema` with `.strict()`, so the `ListMapConfigSchema` record in `view.zod.ts` no longer holds when it says the renderer's schema is a plain `z.object` that parses an undeclared key clean. The three anchors were re-pointed and the two false sentences were qualified in the comment. That prose wants a human read.
- These edits ship inside published text, so `.changeset/objectui-pin-citations-db11afd4967c.md` carries an `@objectstack/spec` patch (commit `d8bac3877d`).

## Resolved since the first report

- **ADR-0087 disposition, the maintainer's ruling** (takeover claim `5903537467` on #20638): `.changeset/console-db11afd4967c.md` now carries `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, worded as in #20436.
  - The diff moves the pin and what travels with it, and adds, removes or renames no ObjectStack-authorable key.
  - The pin-citation re-measure changes describe and migration-entry text only.
  - The 6 declared-breaking entries are objectui's own surfaces (`@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`).
  - `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` exits 0.
- **Base:** `origin/main` `7053333e1e` merged at `ef6276c0e9` through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`. Only `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` overlapped; it text-merged, and `check:migration-registry` reads it current.
- **The two local NOT MEASURED gates now run green:** `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` both exit 0 after a whole-workspace build.

## Boot at the new pin

- `scripts/build-console.sh` at `db11afd4967c`, with this tree's client and spec injected and the canary present. `assert-console-spec-injection` passes: 105 of 145 injected-only descriptions present, all 160 published-only absent. `chunk-membership` reads `client` in `vendor-objectstack`.
- `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --fresh --no-seed-admin`; `bootstrap-status` read `hasOwner: false`.
- Headless Chromium opened `/_console/setup` and submitted the owner form. `bootstrap-status` flipped to `hasOwner: true`, and the session is the new owner (`platform_admin`, `org_owner`). The wizard landed on `/_console/home`, with Showcase and Setup listed.
- Signed in again through `/_console/login`: Showcase opens its Capability Map html page, and Setup opens System Overview. 0 page errors, 0 `TypeError`, 0 5xx. The only 404 is `GET /api/v1/usage/storage`, as at the old pin.

## Governed surface

None of the 20 changed paths is a row of `GOVERNED_SURFACES` in `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` (rows: `docs/adr/`, `.claude/`, `skills/`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`). No release act performed.

Gates at head `ef6276c0e9`: 125 derived, 125 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 unrun; all 125 exit 0. `packages/spec` tests: 16991 passed (576 files). `sdui-parser`: 199 passed. Spec and sdui-parser typecheck clean.
